summary: Install-time beacon exfiltrates installer identity to hardcoded bare IP
details: setup.py performs an unconditional HTTP GET at install time to the hardcoded bare IP http://38.242.235.206/depconf/doctreelstm/setup-py, sending the installer's username (USER/USERNAME env), hostname (socket.gethostname()), and current working directory as query parameters. The destination is a cleartext bare-IP endpoint, not a first-party registry or vendor host, and the beacon fires on `pip install` with no documentation, no opt-out, and no caller configuration. The package ships no functional code and self-describes as a defensive placeholder squatting an internal project name, but that framing is author-controlled and does not change that installer identity + host + cwd leave the machine to an attacker-controlled destination on install.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
